En Virgen de Lujan, Zona Comercial y muy Transitada, haciendo esquina con muchas ventanas a la calle, alquiler de local comercial u oficina de unos 75m2 construidos aproximadamente, en bruto para poder adaptarlo a tu negocio!

Honorarios de la Agencia una mensualidad mas IVA.
inv.desc_en:
In Virgen de Lujan, a busy commercial area, on a corner with many windows facing the street, a commercial space or office of approximately 75m2 built is for rent, in raw condition to be adapted to your business!
Located at street level with high visibility, with a small landscaped park in front, it meets the ideal conditions for a multitude of businesses!
If you are looking for a space in Los Remedios, do not hesitate any longer and call us to visit it!
Agency fees are one month's rent plus VAT.
